About Me

Hey, I'm Aleksandr, a mixing engineer based in Estonia, working mainly with rock and metal.

I love working with heavy guitars, punchy drums and aggressive vocals, but what matters most to me is how everything comes together as a song. I want my mixes to sound powerful and clear without losing the character of the original performance.

I also put a lot of attention into how mixes translate between different listening systems. A mix might sound great on studio headphones, but if it falls apart on everyday speakers, there's still work to do.

I don't believe every song needs the same treatment. I approach each project individually and try to bring out what makes it interesting in the first place.
